description: Checks 2 to 10 Ethereum wallets for shared counterparties: addresses that several of them sent to or received from in their most recent 50 transactions (Blockscout). Reports the shared addresses and a POSSIBLE_CLUSTER signal. Recent-page only, no funding-source trace, so it finds some clusters and misses others. Choose this tool for: Checks 2 to 10 Ethereum wallets for shared counterparties. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_cex_exchange_reserve_flows (Ethereum native-ETH balance snapshot of up to 10 wallets); agent_intel_agent_json_schema_guard (Checks an agent's JSON output against a JSON Schema). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
